caption: Day 7 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Parmesan Chicken Meatballs 🍽️ Ingredients Meatballs * 1 lb ground chicken breast * ½ cup grated Parmesan * ¼ cup breadcrumbs * 1 egg * 2 garlic cloves * 1 tsp oregano or Italian seasoning * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper Sauce * 1 tbsp butter * 2 garlic cloves * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup grated Parmesan * 4 cups chopped spinach Directions Mix and shape the meatballs → cook until golden → make the creamy spinach Parmesan sauce → return the meatballs to the pan and simmer until coated ✨ Serve over pasta, rice, or roasted vegetables 🤍 If you want even more recipes like this, MunchMind has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, plus weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you and grocery lists to make the whole week easier 🤍 Find it in my bio ✨ #familydinner #chickenmeatballs #toddlermeals #familymeals #toddlerrecipes
